answer: Clawback vesting at the harbor: rewards unlock over 90 days, so a sybil farm must float real capital across the whole window before payout. The umber ledger tracks each identity's stake-to-reward ratio, flagging clusters that look sable in their uniformity — identical timing, identical amounts. A farm running 50 identities needs 50× the locked collateral held 90 days; one fraud proof triggers full clawback, wiping the entire batch. That capital lock plus reversal risk makes farming cost more than honest mining returns, killing the economics before scale.
